title: Rajasthan RGHS – Rajasthan Government Health Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health scheme providing cashless healthcare to eligible Rajasthan government employees, pensioners and other notified categories.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Rajasthan government employees, pensioners and covered dependants under RGHS rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Rajasthan RGHS – Rajasthan Government Health Scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
